mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.year asc, c.month asc, c.created_at asc) AS rn, id, title, year || '년 '|| month ||'월' as targetday, hit, (SELECT LISTAGG(ingredient_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ingredient_name) AS ingredients FROM (SELECT DISTINCT i.ingredient_name FROM curation_detail d JOIN ingredient i ON d.ingredient_id = i.id WHERE d.curation_id = c.id )) as incredient_list FROM curation c ORDER BY c.year desc, c.month desc, c.created_at desc OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 15 ROWS ONLY

SELECT d.id, d.sort_order, d.curation_id, d.ingredient_id, i.ingredient_name, r.rcp_seq, r.rcp_nm, r.att_file_no_main, r.hit FROM curation_detail d JOIN ingredient i ON d.ingredient_id = i.id JOIN recipe r ON d.rcp_seq = r.rcp_seq WHERE d.curation_id = #{curation_id} ORDER BY d.sort_order asc, r.hit desc

SELECT i.id, i.ingredient_name, count(d.rcp_seq) FROM ingredient i JOIN ingredient_detail d ON i.id = d.ingredient_id WHERE i.category_name NOT IN ('조미료','유제품/난류','곡류/가공식품', '기타') GROUP BY i.id, i.ingredient_name HAVING COUNT(d.rcp_seq) >= 5 ORDER BY COUNT(d.rcp_seq) DESC FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY
SELECT r.* FROM recipe r JOIN ingredient_detail d ON r.rcp_seq = d.rcp_seq WHERE d.ingredient_id = #{id} ORDER BY r.hit DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert:
SELECT cur_id_seq.nextval FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO curation(id, title, year, month, status, created_at, users_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{year}, #{month}, #{status}, SYSDATE, #{users_id})
INSERT INTO curation_detail(id, sort_order, curation_id, rcp_seq, ingredient_id) VALUES (cur_detail_id_seq.nextval, #{sort_order}, #{curation_id}, #{rcp_seq}, #{ingredient_id})
